approvals.note: Leif approved this bug fix's scope himself on 2026-11-13 after the coordinator agent's (claude-code-t370) summary: a project folder whose name starts with pathspec magic no longer makes the cutoff check report history as unreadable. Prepared and recorded by claude-code-t38p.

approved_scope.title: The cutoff archive-root probe reads the archive root as a literal path
approved_scope.description: The cutoff archive-root probe reads the archive root as a literal path
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-145 and SPEED-1.a.3 require a cutoff without an archive root to read as absent and only an unreadable archive tree to be an error; a project directory beginning with pathspec magic made the fallback probe fail and report could not be read (#990)
acceptance_criteria: for a project in a directory named :(exclude)app whose trusted cutoff has no archive root, the cutoff-tree check answers from the cutoff's own tree instead of reporting that the archive tree could not be read; an unreadable cutoff archive tree is still an error
